fields.quote: The titles seem to be a description and just run off. It's not informative at all.
fields.statement: Web roadmap rows are named by the change set's short title (its display title: the title, else the intent's first clause), with the intent as a secondary line clamped to two lines; the roadmap operation carries that title for each change set

fields.acceptance: An internal/api test asserts roadmap --json gives each change set its display title (a set title, and the intent's first clause when none is set); an internal/web roadmap test renders /roadmap over a fixture whose change set has a long intent and a short title and asserts the row's link text is the title and the intent sits in the secondary line, and the stylesheet clamps that line to two lines; describe-golden.txtar is regenerated
fields.statement: Each change set row on the web roadmap shows the change set's title (as change ls shows it), with its intent beneath as a secondary line clamped to two lines, and any depends-on note kept on the row; the roadmap operation's change sets carry that title as a title field
